Libraries: Jetpack Compose, Material 3 and other AndroidX libraries (Google, Apache 2.0); Kotlin and kotlinx.coroutines (JetBrains, Apache 2.0); Material Icons (Google, Apache 2.0); SQLite (public domain); zstd (Meta, BSD) and zstd-jni (Luben Karavelov, BSD); Bouncy Castle (MIT); the Suvii library (marybezuhla, GPL-3.0-or-later). The full list is in NOTICE.md in the code.

Chynnist shows no ads, collects nothing and has no accounts. The settings stay on this phone only and are not copied to the cloud or to a new phone.

The idea of making handy Ukrainian apps that ask for as few permissions as possible and work well offline came while I was working at my laptop in near darkness: after yet another Russian drone attack, the power was gone again. That is how Chynnist began: the legislation of Ukraine always at hand, even with no internet.

Chynnist was made in Ukraine 🇺🇦. Laws are the rules we live by together. Let us know our rights and duties, and read the laws ourselves, at the source. This is who we are, and it is alive. We are alive.

Chynnist is free software: its code is open, and anyone can check what it does. No ads, no tracking, no accounts. Freedom in software is not a small thing. It is the right to know what happens on your phone, and not to hand your life to anyone.

Yet since 2014, and since 24 February 2022 at full force, Russia has been waging war against my country. Every day, missiles and drones strike cities, homes, hospitals and power plants. The occupiers kill, abduct Ukrainian children, destroy museums, churches and libraries, and ban our language in the lands they hold. Their aim is for Ukrainians to cease to exist as a people.
We are fighting for the right to be: to live on our own land, speak our own language, create our own things. The freedom you value in software is, for us today, a matter of life.
If Chynnist is useful to you, please support Ukraine. I receive none of this money: the links go straight to the organisations\' official sites.
If you are from Ukraine: thank you for being here. We hold on. We defend, we donate, we look after one another and we choose Ukrainian: together, this brings victory closer.
The links open in your browser, on the organisations\' own sites. The app knows nothing about it and receives nothing.
The national Red Cross society: help for people hurt by the war
Ukraine\'s state defence technology cluster: learn how Ukraine builds them
The same platform: medical aid, humanitarian demining, rebuilding
National Bank of Ukraine special account

You can also support any trusted foundation, volunteers or unit you know. Check fundraisers: official details and reports.
The texts and cards of documents come from the Open Data Portal of the Verkhovna Rada of Ukraine. The portal allows free use and sharing of the data, with a reference to the source.
Chynnist is not an official publication. Official texts are published in the publications named by law.
